technicalExplanationOfSingleBoundaryReso.rule: In src/time.ts, bounds({earliest: null, latest: null}) returns [-Infinity, Infinity], so interval(assignment).certain is [startMax, endMin]. Whenever either validFrom.latest is null or validTo.earliest is null, certain[0] > certain[1] (empty certain span), so temporalMatch is 'possible' and resolveAirport() returns status='uncertain' rather than 'resolved'. Consequently, boundary-only candidates with an unknown outer endpoint produce 0 new 'resolved' queries and instead transition 'not_found -> uncertain' across their possible half-plane until paired with a second dated boundary.
